items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: Because I played for Al. Yeah, Al Hibbler.

ctx.x: And “Trees.” [sings] “I think that I shall never see/A poem lovely as a tree.” Yeah that was a blind man. That was his thing. Because I played for Al. Yeah, Al Hibbler. And he would hang out at this night club after we got through playing the show, and it was called Benny Rivers. And he’d tell all the guys, and they’d have bets, and money was passing along, and he says, “All right Al, what’s coming now?” He said he could tell an ugly woman or a pretty one. He’s blind you know, right? And so now they didn’t know…
Well the attitude and the sound.
